title.en: balon, the saturday flea market in borgo dora.
title.de: balon, der samstags-flohmarkt in borgo dora.
title.tr: borgo dora'da balon, cumartesi pire pazarı.

line.en: every saturday from 7 to 18 in the streets round borgo dora. old things, cheap things, a lot of people. go in the late morning.
line.de: jeden samstag von 7 bis 18 uhr in den straßen um borgo dora. altes, billiges, viele leute. am besten am späten vormittag.
line.tr: her cumartesi 7'den 18'e borgo dora çevresindeki sokaklarda. eski şeyler, ucuz şeyler, çok insan. öğleye doğru git.

sparks.why: Balon del sabato, every saturday 7:00 to 18:00 around borgo dora and porta palazzo; guidatorino.com's balon guide lists the 7 nov market.
